admission.justification: Spans application/knowledge_paging/tree_read.py and models/tools/tool_answer.py, is guarded by focused projection, answer-table, and stdio memory tests, and prevents raising knowledge_read's batch envelope from silently breaking legacy tree-view pagination and stdio memory bounds.

applicability: Delivered page-size budgeting for mounted knowledge_read legacy tree views (source_context, invariant, family) versus verbatim batch records.
conditions: application/knowledge_paging/tree_read.py::_delivered_bound returns TOOL_ANSWER_EXCEPTION_MAX_TOKENS (4,000 tokens) for cut_page across source_context, invariant, and family walks.
models/tools/tool_answer.py::TOOL_ANSWER_EXCEPTIONS retains ('knowledge_read', None): 5000 so verbatim batch records keep their 5,000-token envelope bound.
exclusions: Does not alter the internal 8,000-token knowledge_paging threshold metadata or the 3,500-token impact and search query view budgets.

evidence: BUG-R64@v1 §3; pytest mcp/tests/test_knowledge_name_projection.py mcp/tests/test_kno_r07_knowledge_queries.py mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py and pytest -m integration mcp/tests/test_mcp_memory_bounded_stdio.py; role-reports/worker/5da3c782-cae6-5289-9d7e-0bc71bba6ae3/role-launch/261112-BUG-L64-worker-5da3c782-cae6-5289-9d7e-0bc71bba6ae3.md

statement: Legacy tree-view paging in tree_read._delivered_bound cuts source_context, invariant, and family pages at TOOL_ANSWER_EXCEPTION_MAX_TOKENS (4,000 tokens), while TOOL_ANSWER_EXCEPTIONS[('knowledge_read', None)] stays at 5,000 tokens for verbatim batch records.
title: Legacy tree_read pages cut at 4,000 while knowledge_read keeps 5,000
